🔴 Red Eye? It May Not Be Just an Infection.

Many people assume that a red eye is caused by an infection or allergy. However, in some cases, it may be a sign of uveitis—inflammation inside the eye that can threaten vision if left untreated.

Watch out for symptoms such as:
✔ Eye redness
✔ Eye pain
✔ Sensitivity to light
✔ Blurred vision

Early diagnosis and treatment are essential to prevent complications and protect your eyesight.

If you are experiencing persistent redness or any of these symptoms, don’t ignore them. A comprehensive eye examination can help identify the cause and ensure timely treatment.

At Globus Eye Org, our specialists provide expert diagnosis and management of uveitis and other inflammatory eye conditions.

🌐

👁️ 5 Things to Check Before Cataract Surgery

Cataract surgery is one of the safest and most successful eye procedures, but achieving the best visual outcome starts with proper pre-surgical planning.

Before your surgery, make sure you discuss these important checks with your eye specialist:

✅ Detailed Eye Measurements (Biometry)
✅ Dry Eye Assessment & Treatment
✅ Review of Medical Conditions & Medications
✅ Retina, Macula & Glaucoma Evaluation
✅ Selection of the Right Intraocular Lens (IOL)

These evidence-based assessments help improve surgical planning, optimize visual outcomes, and ensure realistic expectations after surgery.

At Globus Eye Org, we believe every cataract surgery should be personalized to the patient’s eye health, lifestyle needs, and visual goals. Our comprehensive pre-operative evaluation helps us recommend the most suitable treatment plan and lens option for each patient.

👁️ MYTH BUSTED!

Myth: Cataracts only affect older people.

✅ Fact: While cataracts are more common with age, they can also occur in younger individuals due to diabetes, eye injuries, prolonged steroid use, certain eye diseases, or even congenital causes.

Early detection is the key to preserving your vision. If you’re experiencing blurred vision, glare, or difficulty seeing clearly, don’t ignore the signs.

This Cataract Awareness Month, let’s replace myths with facts and encourage regular eye check-ups for everyone—regardless of age.

🌧️ Monsoon Eye Care Tips: Protect Your Vision This Rainy Season! 👁️

The monsoon season can increase the risk of eye infections, allergies, and irritation due to increased humidity, dust, and germs. Taking a few simple precautions can help keep your eyes healthy.

✅ Avoid rubbing your eyes
✅ Keep your spectacles clean
✅ Follow proper contact lens hygiene
✅ Don’t ignore redness, pain, itching, or excessive watering
✅ Stay hydrated and maintain good eye hygiene

Ocular Sarcoidosis: Protecting Your Vision Through Early Diagnosis 👁️

Did you know that sarcoidosis can affect the eyes and, in some patients, eye inflammation may be the first sign of the disease?

Ocular sarcoidosis can present with blurred vision, floaters, eye redness, light sensitivity, or recurrent episodes of uveitis. If left untreated, it can lead to complications such as cataract, glaucoma, macular edema, and permanent vision loss.

At Globus Eye Org, our uveitis specialists provide comprehensive evaluation and evidence-based management of ocular inflammatory diseases. Diagnosis often requires collaboration with rheumatologists, pulmonologists, and physicians to assess for systemic involvement.

Treatment is individualized and may include:
• Steroid eye drops
• Oral medications
• Periocular or intraocular injections
• Immunomodulatory therapy
• Biologic agents in selected patients

Early diagnosis and a multidisciplinary approach offer the best chance of preserving vision and improving long-term outcomes.

If you are experiencing persistent eye redness, floaters, blurred vision, or recurrent eye inflammation, schedule a comprehensive eye examination with a uveitis specialist.
